name: StressAway
summary: Step into a tranquil world with StressAway, your virtual reality sanctuary designed to melt away stress and restore inner calm. Choose from a variety of breathtaking sceneries, from sun-kissed beaches to serene mountain vistas, each carefully crafted to transport you to a place of serenity. Whether you have 5, 10, or 20 minutes to spare, embark on a guided meditation journey led by soothing narration, complemented by gentle imagery and immersive sounds.
